sessions.phase_label: Agriculture homepage and dynamic feature implementation

requirements.title: Accounting Services Homepage Mockup
requirements.definition: Implement the supplied accounting-services homepage design as the requested WordPress page.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the single accounting-services homepage conversion; no independently evolving sub-behaviors are visible in the supplied evidence.

requirements.title: August 2022 Page Creation
requirements.definition: Create the new page requested in August 2022 before the client withdrew the assignment because it had been completed elsewhere.
requirements.boundary_note: The page identity and detailed design are unavailable, but the page-creation obligation and its later withdrawal are independently observable.

requirements.title: Doctor Homepage from Figma
requirements.definition: Implement the supplied Doctor Figma design as the requested WordPress homepage.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the complete Doctor homepage mockup conversion; no separate interactive or content behaviors are specified.

requirements.title: Central Urology One-Page Website
requirements.definition: Implement the supplied Central Urology Figma design as a complete one-page WordPress website.
requirements.boundary_note: The one-page extent and accepted two-to-three-day delivery proposal are attributes of this single site-delivery obligation, not separate product Requirements.

requirements.title: Agriculture Homepage Layout
requirements.definition: Implement the supplied Agriculture Figma homepage layout in WordPress, excluding the separately testable animated counters and latest-news behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers visual and structural mockup conversion only; moving-number animation and latest-news population can fail or change independently and are separate siblings.

requirements.title: Agriculture Animated Counters
requirements.definition: Display the Agriculture homepage number statistics as animated moving counters similar to the referenced example.
requirements.boundary_note: Counter animation has its own expected runtime behavior and can be implemented or fail independently of the page layout and news feed.

requirements.title: Agriculture Latest News Feed
requirements.definition: Populate the Agriculture homepage latest-news section from the site's latest news content.
requirements.boundary_note: Dynamic latest-news population is independently testable and distinct from the static homepage layout and animated counters.

requirements.title: November 2023 Elementor Mockup Project
requirements.definition: Apply the project's mockup to the prepared WordPress installation using Elementor Pro, with fast completion requested.
requirements.boundary_note: Fast completion is a delivery constraint of the mockup implementation; no detailed mockup or independently evolving sub-feature is present in the visible history.

requirements.title: February 2024 Elementor Figma Page
requirements.definition: Implement the supplied February 2024 Figma page in the prepared WordPress and Elementor Pro installation.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers one Figma-to-Elementor page conversion; the request for a readiness date is treated as part of delivery coordination because no concrete deadline is established.

requirements.title: PHPC Homepage from Figma
requirements.definition: Implement the supplied PHPC homepage Figma design in the prepared WordPress and Elementor installation.
requirements.boundary_note: The observable client request covers the homepage only; other site pages are excluded because they are raised only as an unanswered freelancer question.

unresolved_candidates.description: The freelancer asks whether additional PHPC pages are to be completed by the client, but no client message clearly requests those pages from the freelancer; they are not included as a Requirement.
The July 2024 exchange establishes urgency and availability but no software behavior or deliverable details before the prospective client work is cancelled.
